children.value:
Nonhomogeneous, first-order ODEs with constant coefficients are nice to solve
with Laplace transforms:

children.html: y′+by=r(t),y(0)=y0y' + by = r(t), \quad y(0) = y_0y′+by=r(t),y(0)=y0​
